tools.name: memsea_recall
tools.description: Search the long-term memory sea for things that were said or written before — earlier conversations, promises, facts about the person, diary entries. Use this whenever you need to remember something that may have been cleared from the current context; the sea is built from the raw logs and never forgets on its own. Read-only. Returns matches with their timestamps and who said them, most relevant first.

query.description: What to look for, in Chinese. Keywords work better than a whole question.

k.description: How many memories to return. Default 8, max 30.

days.description: How far back to look, in days. Default 30, max 365.

summary.zh: 在记忆海里按关键词找以前的对话、约定、事实和日记（只读，不受上下文清理影响）。
summary.en: Searches the memory sea for earlier conversations, promises, facts and diary entries. Read-only.
